title: The Smile of the Ninth Floor
author: Y. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Zephyrine Winterbourne, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
